description: Weekly dependency updates, collected into a single merge request.

packageRules.description: npm (bun): keep exact versions in package.json
Cargo: write the new version into Cargo.toml as well (Cargo.lock + --locked is the pin)
Wait a few days before taking new package releases (yanked / compromised releases)
Major updates can break things: they are listed on the Dependency Dashboard and only get an MR when ticked there
svelte-check only supports TypeScript ^5 || ^6 (the bot is not affected)

customManagers.description: Versions annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' in shell scripts
BuildKit image used by 'docker buildx create' in the GitLab CI
